title: Add RAG agent examples, tool-calling samples, and docs site updates
author: Aisha Patel
description:
This PR adds a small collection of realistic RAG agent templates and tool-calling examples for both Python and TypeScript, plus the corresponding documentation site updates and quickstart instructions. Motivation: provide maintainable, copy-pasteable examples for engineers adopting RAG + agents with tool-calls using the Redwood API and the new agent conventions. The change set includes three agent templates (basic, retrieval-first, multi-tool), two runnable examples (python and typescript) that demonstrate tool registration and streaming responses, and docs site updates with a new quickstart guide, example snippets, and sidebar navigation entries. These examples are intentionally small and focused to lower the ramp for SDK users and to serve as canonical reference code for the docs site. Checklist:
- [x] Add agent templates under redwood-examples/rag/templates
- [x] Add python and typescript tool-calling examples under redwood-examples/agents
- [x] Update docs site: /docs/guides/rag and quickstarts
- [x] Add minimal CI smoke test for examples
- [x] Address initial reviewer feedback and fix typos

Notes: examples are framework-agnostic (no heavy deps), they use the SDK client patterns from the docs and include instructions for running locally and on Redwood Dedicated. Where appropriate the templates include configuration knobs (max_tokens, model_variant, retrieval_strategy) and comments about production hardening (auth, KMS for keys, rate limits).
